baseline.description: No change: keep the current setup
baseline.variant_facts:
The merchandise under consideration is a Switch harness for use in a gas range. A switch harness used as an ignition trigger for a gas range cooktop, comprised of a set of insulated cable conductors with an electrical connector at the end and multiple compression switches attached. Each switch includes a switch base, contacts, a cam button, and a switch cover. The Switch harness for use in a gas range is assembled in Thailand using components sourced from China.

The Insulated wire harness, Electrical connector, Switch base, Switch contacts, Cam button and Switch cover are produced in China. 

Final assembly in Thailand: Place the wire harness within the switch base; Assemble remainder of switch parts including contacts and cam button on top of the base; Place the switch cover over the assemblies; Test the finished harness and package for shipment.

key_factors: Insulated wire harness and switch components
prediction.decisive_step: Manufacturing of the insulated wire harness and switch components in China
prediction.reasoning: All components, including the insulated wire harness, electrical connector, and switch parts, are manufactured in China and have a predetermined end-use. Consistent with CBP precedents N350058, N335078, and N340243, the simple assembly of pre-manufactured wire harnesses, connectors, and switch components in Thailand (placing the harness in the base, adding contacts, cam button, and cover, followed by testing) is mere assembly that does not result in a substantial transformation. Therefore, the country of origin remains China.

plans.description: Make Cable insulation and jacket and Connectors and housings in Thailand
plans.variant_facts:
The merchandise under consideration is a Switch harness for use in a gas range. A switch harness used as an ignition trigger for a gas range cooktop, comprised of a set of insulated cable conductors with an electrical connector at the end and multiple compression switches attached. Each switch includes a switch base, contacts, a cam button, and a switch cover. The Switch harness for use in a gas range is assembled in Thailand using components sourced from Thailand.

The Insulated wire harness, Electrical connector, Switch base, Switch contacts, Cam button and Switch cover are produced in Thailand. 

In Thailand, the Insulated wire harness will be produced in-house: extrude PVC or polymer insulation around conducting cores; wrap insulated cores with aluminum-mylar tape, drain wires, and braided metal shielding; extrude outer protective jacket and wind bulk unterminated cable onto reels (assumed from the product-family template; no operations were supplied for this group).

In Thailand, the Electrical connector, Switch base, Switch contacts, Cam button and Switch cover will be produced in-house: stamp, form, and coat metal electrical terminals, plugs, clamps, and coupler contacts; injection-mold plastic connector shells, adapter plates, splice trays, and enclosure housings (assumed from the product-family template; no operations were supplied for this group).

Final assembly in Thailand: Place the wire harness within the switch base; Assemble remainder of switch parts including contacts and cam button on top of the base; Place the switch cover over the assemblies; Test the finished harness and package for shipment.

key_factors: The insulated cable conductors and compression switches produced in Thailand
prediction.decisive_step: Production of the insulated wire conductors and switch components, as well as final assembly, in Thailand
prediction.reasoning: All components—including the insulated wire harness, electrical connector, switch base, contacts, cam button, and switch cover—are wholly produced in Thailand, and final assembly also takes place in Thailand. Furthermore, consistent with CBP precedents N335078 and N340244, the country of origin of a wire harness is imparted by the insulated conducting wires, which are manufactured in Thailand.

verdict.reasoning: In Variant A, all components (insulated wire harness, electrical connector, switch base, contacts, cam button, and cover) are manufactured in China and undergo simple assembly in Thailand, conferring Chinese origin. In Variant B, production of the insulated wire harness and all switch and connector components moves entirely to Thailand, where final assembly also occurs. Under CBP rulings on wire harnesses and gas range ignition assemblies (e.g., N335078, N340243, N350058), the country where the insulated cable assembly and functional components are manufactured determines origin. Because all component manufacturing and assembly occur in Thailand in Variant B, origin changes to Thailand.
